newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Crown Vantage Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Crown Vantage Q2 results.

text.p: a) Loss per share is based upon 8,937,280 and 8,562,097 weighted average shares outstanding for the quarters ended June 1997 and June 1996 respectively, and 8,736,514 weighted average shares outstanding for the quarter ended March 1997. (The number of shares considered outstanding does not include 483,615 shares, 308,209 shares and 77,154 shares held by the Employee Stock Ownership Plan Trust at June 29, 1997, June 30, 1996 and March 30, 1997, respectively. In accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, shares held by the Trust are not considered outstanding for earnings per share calculations until the shares are committed for release from the Trust.)
For the Six Months Ended June 29, 1997 and June 30, 1996
(in thousands of dollars, except per share; unaudited)

(b) Earnings per share is based upon 8,836,897 and 8,543,021 weighted average shares outstanding for the six months ended June 29, 1997 and June 30, 1996 respectively. (The number of shares considered outstanding does not include 483,615 shares and 308,209 shares held by the Employee Stock Ownership Plan Trust at June 29, 1997, and June 30, 1996 respectively. In accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, shares held by the Trust are not considered outstanding for earnings per share calculations until the shares are committed for release from the Trust.)
